items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: So I come back man, call Thelonius, and say "Yeah I want you to join my band he say".

ctx.x: So I come back man, call Thelonius, and say "Yeah I want you to join my band he say". "I say fine." "Yes sir. I say, uhm, are we going to have some rehearsals?" He say, "I don't rehearse. Bam, hung up." You know, I say, God dog, you don't rehearse, how I'm gonna do, what I'm gonna do in this band, Christ man, so uhm so I call Charlie Rouse up man, and I say man, what's happening man, and Rouse is bad, I don't know he say, I say well how do you learn the song? He say man, I just keep bugging Thelonius until he try…
